podcast.title: Band's Recent Activity and Confirmation Challenges
podcast.body: Tul has not been very active in recent years, which makes it difficult to confirm any new discoveries made by fans regarding "Lateralus" from the past five or six years. This lack of recent presence contributes to the ongoing mystery and unverified nature of many fan theories. "Tul es una banda que no ha estado tampoco muy presente en los últimos años con lo cual yo creo que los últimos 5 o 6 años de gente que firma ver descubierto cosas en la teráluz de Tul pues ya están lejos de poder ser confirmadas."

podcast.title: Band's Secrecy and Fan Engagement
podcast.body: Tul is known for not explicitly revealing the secrets and inspirations embedded in their albums, instead allowing fans to embark on a quest to discover them. This creates a "fun game" for fans, though it also leads to frustration when the band does not confirm fan-discovered secrets, a game that many still participate in years later. "La banda tampoco ayuda demasiado porque nos habla un montón de todos esos secretos inspiraciones y escondrijos que recorren todos los discos de Tul en general, pero tampoco nos da datos para que un poco peleemos para intentar encontrarlos, lo cual genera un juego muy divertido entre los fans."

podcast.title: Mathematical Composition of Lateralus
podcast.body: The album "Lateralus" is renowned for its structural and rhythmic complexity, where almost all instruments operate within an intricate mathematical order based on the Fibonacci sequence. This includes syllable counts in vocal stanzas, Golden Ratio application in verse/stanza time structures, and precise rhythmic patterns in drums, bass, and guitar, even influencing song lengths and overall album duration, with complex time signature changes derived from the Fibonacci series. "casi todos los instrumentos trabajan en un complejísimo orden matemático basado en la serie de Fibonacci."

podcast.title: Unconfirmed Fan Discoveries
podcast.body: Over the years, dedicated fans have tirelessly searched for Golden Ratio proportions and Fibonacci sequences within the "Lateralus" album, uncovering highly complex patterns. While some claim to have even created new rhythmically coherent songs by reassembling parts of existing tracks based on these mathematical principles, the band typically refrains from confirming these findings, either due to their perceived inaccuracy or to maintain the ongoing "game" with their fanbase. "En parte porque yo creo que son mentira, en parte porque yo creo que le gusta seguir el juego a todos los afidianados."

podcast.title: Years of Mathematical Experimentation
podcast.body: The band Tul dedicated years to mathematically manipulating the rhythmic structures of the "Lateralus" album. This extensive experimentation aimed to integrate complex mathematical concepts into the music, resulting in one of the most rhythmically complex albums ever written, a feat considered almost impossible to achieve while maintaining musicality. "Tul se pasó años jugando matemáticamente con las estructuras ríntmicas del disco."
